name: blue-sweater-intro-video
title: Brand Intro to Follow Card
description: Brand intro that ends on a follow: a word bursts into red blocks that assemble the wordmark, a Claude window types a request and sends it, the answer opens an X profile card and the cursor clicks follow. Word, wordmark, prompt, avatar, name, handle, bio and button labels are variables; the Claude window keeps its native colours; holds or fades.
